# pushward_org (Data Source)

The organization the provider's key belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pushward_org" "this" {}

output "seats_free" {
  value = data.pushward_org.this.member_limit - data.pushward_org.this.member_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the organization was created.
- `delete_after` (String) When a restricted organization is deleted, if automatic deletion is on.
- `id` (String) Organization id.
- `member_count` (Number) Members now.
- `member_limit` (Number) Most members the organization may have.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `plan` (String) `comp`, `trial`, `team` or `enterprise`.
- `role` (String) The role the key acts as: `admin` for a manage key, `viewer` for a read key.
- `seats` (Number) Seats a team or enterprise organization pays for.
- `slug` (String) URL slug.
- `status` (String) `active` or `restricted`.
- `trial_ends_at` (String) When the trial ends; only while the plan is `trial`.
